description: Implementation of the VideoFrameTracker class for tracking video frame rendering and dropped frames on Android platform.

classes.name: VideoFrameTracker
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking video frame rendering, managing frame timestamps, and calculating dropped frames.

methods.name: OnInputBuffer
methods.description: Handles input buffer timestamps, maintaining a sorted list of frames to be rendered.

methods.name: OnFrameRendered
methods.description: Records the timestamp of a rendered frame.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Sets the seek time and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateAndGetDroppedFrames
methods.description: Updates internal state and returns the number of dropped frames.

methods.name: UpdateDroppedFrames
methods.description: Analyzes rendered frames against input frames to determine which frames were dropped.
